title: Renewable Wither
description: This makes the wither drop three wither skeleton skulls in addition to a nether star. It's perfect for wither farms, or just to remove a tedious task.
body:
![Minecraft title text. The top is flaming, saying renewable wither. The bottom is blue, saying abyssal vanguard.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/081283902dd16680b06f6924c4511802a922709d.png)
## Renewable Wither
Have you ever spent hours trying to get all 3 skulls for your wither with little to no luck? Everyone's gone through it.
This datapack makes it so you only have to grind for it once. After that, the wither will give back its skulls, letting you fight it again once you recover.

### Why This Matters
Less Grind For Beacons: Instead of going back to the nether over and over again to get skulls, you can just reuse the ones from the wither you killed.
Perfect For Farms: Collect the skulls dropped from the wither and you'll be able to put them right back to use in a farm.
Lightweight & Seamless: The pack only uses loot tables, so it's extremely performance-friendly and safe to use with your friends.

### Compatibility
Works with 1.21 and newer
Compatible with most datapacks and mods

If you enjoy a relaxed playthrough and need beacons fast, this pack was built for you.

Made by MeowingChip5
